conservation.condition_narrative: "Varnished in 1962 by Fine Arts Conservation Laboratories. With this coat of co-polymer iso and n-butyl methacrylate" (Doris Bry typed label).
conservation.report_notes: Published with corresponding artwork entry in *Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999), this historical conservation information documents treatment decisions made during the artist’s lifetime. Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

cr_data.provenance: (Doris Bry, New York, NY); Private collection, Atlantic Beach, New York, 1972; Lisa Kurts Fine Art, Memphis, Tennessee, 1997 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks note backing inscription. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, backing inscription, 1940 New York (An American Place–O'Keeffe) exhibition checklist.
titles.title: Hibiscus

description: Swirling hibiscus flowers in shades of red, pink, orange, and yellow fill the canvas. Their soft petals contrast with bright, textured pistils that emerge from their centers. Small flashes of blue background are visible behind the cluster of blooms.
title: Hibiscus
